quarterly_data.quarter: IonQ press release: IonQ to Advance Quantum Supercomputing by Bringing First (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IonQ's Superion 256 will be the first on-premise quantum processor at the NVIDIA Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC), installed and linked with an NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 system via NVIDIA NVQLink with workloads orchestrated by NVIDIA CUDA-Q, for a joint research program on hybrid software and large-scale system prototyping; installation at NVAQC is scheduled for next year. IonQ introduced its sixth-generation Superion platform on Sept. 8, 2026; the Superion 256 system is available to order now, with first customer deliveries expected in 2027. CEO Niccolo de Masi: the roadmap to 10,000 qubits and full fault tolerance is accelerating through vertical integration of its SkyWater CMOS foundry.
quarterly_data.figure: Superion 256 first customer deliveries expected in 2027
